label: preparing
what: A coordinated bread-supplied gathering in the great hall at eighteen hundred, with its actual occasion withheld from the mayor. Innkeeper explicitly names himself, builder and freight as the hospitality committee; 201 fresh loaves were reported reserved in the hall. Baker and neighbour appear involved through baking and reported bakery coordination, though neighbour also asks about the occasion, so their knowledge of the underlying purpose is uncertain. Secretary knowingly helps schedule the appointment and escort the mayor precisely at eighteen, not early, but says no agenda was supplied. The exact purpose is not established; the reported bridge/port change is unverified.
